name: Rialto Marketplace
demographics: Rialto Marketplace serves a diverse, working-class community with a 1-mile population of 18,386 and 3-mile population of 149,431. The trade area features median household incomes around $67,000, indicating middle-income families who value convenient shopping for everyday needs. The center attracts a broad demographic mix typical of the Inland Empire region, with families seeking value-oriented retail and dining options. With over 35,000 daily vehicle trips passing the intersection of Riverside Avenue and San Bernardino, the center captures significant drive-by traffic from commuters and local residents.
description: Rialto Marketplace is a newly completed shopping center development strategically located at 1276 Riverside Avenue in Rialto, California, at the high-traffic intersection of Riverside Avenue and San Bernardino. This modern 239,552 square foot community center serves the growing Inland Empire market with convenient access to over 149,000 residents within a 3-mile radius. The center benefits from exceptional visibility with 35,469 cars passing daily, making it a prime destination for both planned shopping trips and impulse visits. Developed and managed by NewMark Merrill Companies, a respected retail real estate firm known for creating vibrant community gathering places, Rialto Marketplace offers a diverse mix of national retailers, restaurants, and service providers. The center features ample parking, modern architecture, and continues to offer restaurant, shop, and pad availability for additional tenants, positioning it as a dynamic and evolving retail destination in San Bernardino County.
summary: Rialto Marketplace is a newly completed 239,552 square foot community shopping center at the busy intersection of Riverside Avenue and San Bernardino in Rialto, California. With over 35,000 daily vehicle trips and serving 149,000+ residents within 3 miles, this modern development offers diverse retail, dining, and service options with ongoing leasing opportunities.
